allowed_source: litmus-x86 checker (x86tso.cat transcription, tested not proved) on the IR lifted from objdump's reading of the compiled bytes; not herd7, not Lean
provenance: C sources: examples/litmus-c; objects pinned in examples/litmus-c/objects.sha256.
Disassembler (lifting only): GNU objdump (GNU Binutils for Ubuntu) 2.42
Layout: data at 0x10000 (one 64-byte slot per location, specification order); thread k's code relocated to 0x400000 + 0x1000*k; the final ret is dropped.
xl = tso: every data access is an aligned whole-location 4-byte write-back access (checked by the checker's scope), so Exec.xl_iff_tso_of_tame applies; not computed separately.
